_note: DRAFT lines, Dee approves before anything goes live. Voice: the app's Kokoro af_heart from the box.

lines.arrival: Hi. I'm ANITA. Walk with me.
lines.who: I'm a personal AI. I live on your phone, not in a chat window. You talk to me like a person, and I listen while I speak, so cut in whenever you like.
lines.memory: I remember what every AI forgets. Your people, your plans, what you were worried about last Tuesday. Ask me, and I'll tell you.
lines.yours: And my memory of you is yours alone. It stays on your device, and on hardware you own. One switch keeps everything on the phone.
lines.today: This runs today. Five layers of memory. Three ways of thinking. Full two-way voice. And more than fifteen hundred tests passing on the machine that runs me.
lines.body: Here's why a robotics company built me first. A robot in your home will only be as good as what it knows about you. So I learn you now, on the phone you already carry. When the body is ready, I move in with everything I know. Same memory. Same voice. Same me.
lines.others: Other companions live in someone's cloud. I live with you. Other assistants start every day from zero. I start from yesterday.
lines.door: Early access opens with the iOS app. Leave your email, and you'll hear from the founder himself. I'll be here.
lines.screens: I live on your phone today, and in your WhatsApp. Next, your laptop, your watch, and your browser, where I can book, fill in, and ask, with your yes every time. One day, a body. Wherever you are, same memory, same voice, same me.
